subject: Mobile Development
title: Play Store Ratings and Reviews
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Play Store Ratings and Reviews.

hook.text: A one-star review can tank an app's visibility. Ratings are life or death for developers.

buildup.text: Google Play's algorithm weighs recent reviews more heavily than old ones.

discovery.text: Developers can respond publicly to reviews, turning complaints into visible customer service.

twist.text: Fake review farms sell five-star ratings. Both stores constantly fight fake reviews.

climax.text: Ratings determine search rankings, which determine downloads, which determine survival.

punchline.text: Stars decide which apps live and which die.

quiz.question: How do fake review farms affect app stores?
options: They sell fake five-star ratings to boost apps
They help users find better apps
